claims.object_text: vesicle-associated protein involved in neural crest cell and neuronal migration, maturation, and neurotransmission
claims.quote: TBC1D24 is a vesicle-associated protein involved in neural crest cell and neuronal migration, maturation, and neurotransmission.
TBC1D24 has been detected in auditory neurons

claims.object_text: detected in glia-like non-sensory epithelial cells during early developmental stages
claims.quote: TBC1D24 was detected in glia-like non-sensory epithelial cells during early developmental stages.

claims.object_text: virtually absent in adjacent sensory hair cells
claims.quote: TBC1D24 was virtually absent in adjacent sensory hair cells.

claims.object_text: expression distinguishing non-sensory from sensory epithelial cells almost disappears around the onset of hearing

claims.object_text: could regulate vesicle trafficking in cochlear glia-like non-sensory epithelial cells
claims.quote: The present observations suggest that TBC1D24 could also regulate vesicle trafficking in cochlear glia-like non-sensory epithelial cells.

claims.object_text: mainly described as a neuronal protein either in the brain or in the cochlea
